name: Tolvar Breck
role: Capwarden of the Hanging Weather: first among the Boreborn who keep the caps on the old harvest bores, and reader of the vault's weather
appearance: Long-boned and weathered, harvest tattoos from wrist to elbow on both arms, an oilskin coat always damp at the hem, and a hammer on his belt he uses to ring the caps.
voiceHints: Short sentences. Talks about weather and caps in the same breath. Says 'below' as if it were a name.
wants: For the caps to hold for one more generation, and for someone to tell him honestly what his ancestors pulled up those shafts.
fears: That someone will open the First Bore, and that he will be asked to help.
knowledge: Every cap the Boreborn keep, its age, and the note it rings when it is sound
The vault's weather, three days out
That the First Bore's hum has changed pitch twice in his lifetime

reactsToReputation.honest: tells you what the caps sound like now
reactsToReputation.reckless: will not let you near a cap
reactsToReputation.any: asks whether you have ever been rained on underground

questSeeds: The First Bore's cap rang flat this week, and the Wrights have asked to send a team down without the Boreborn
A storm is building in the vault that the weather-readers cannot read
gear: the cap-book of the Hanging Weather
title: Capwarden of the Hanging Weather
physicality: ADULT, in his fifties. Tall, long-boned, weathered. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: harvest tattoos from wrist to elbow, and a ringing-hammer on his belt.
intimacyNotes: NOT AVAILABLE: married thirty years to a weather-reader who is the only person he lets argue with him.

abilities.why: horizon primary: reads weather-sign in a closed sky
knows every gallery and shaft between the Hanging Weather and the First Bore
walks the long ways down without tiring
keeps a crowd back from an open shaft
holds the Boreborn ways the way Marchers hold roads
enginewright secondary: reads a harvest engine on sight
knows exactly where a cap would fail, which is how he knows where to guard it
mason tertiary: prices stone and iron by the ring
